Mesa pickups, from Dobson Ranch to Las Sendas and Eastmark

Scottsdale Sprinters is a Scottsdale chauffeured transportation company serving metro Phoenix. Mesa is the largest city we serve by area, and the work spreads with it: Downtown Mesa around the Mesa Arts Center and the Fiesta District, Dobson Ranch in West Mesa, Red Mountain and Las Sendas in the northeast, and the Eastmark and Superstition Springs side out east.

How we work in Mesa

Mesa groups almost always start from more than one address. A single chauffeured vehicle running a short multi-stop pickup loop — a few houses in Dobson Ranch, one more in Alta Mesa — costs less and lands everyone together, which matters when the destination is a wedding, a flight or a corporate start time.

Where we pick up in Mesa

We pick up across Downtown and Central Mesa, West Mesa around Dobson Ranch, North Mesa near Lehi, the northeast at Las Sendas, Red Mountain Ranch and Mountain Bridge, and East and Southeast Mesa around Superstition Springs, Signal Butte, Eastmark and Cadence. Phoenix-Mesa Gateway sits on the southeast side; Sky Harbor is the usual choice from West Mesa.

What a booking costs in Mesa

The fleet seats 6 to 56. Below are the Sprinters first, then the group end, each with the rate, the minimum, what that minimum comes to and the per-person figure the pricing page publishes for the same vehicle, on the same basis. The full grid is on the pricing page, and it is the same grid in Mesa as everywhere else we serve.

An hourly charter carries a 4-hour minimum on every listed vehicle, and a 5-hour minimum on the 56-Passenger Motorcoach. A point-to-point transfer has no hourly minimum at all: it is flat within 15 road miles from pickup to drop-off, and a longer transfer is priced from the drive with the empty return included, with the basis shown on the quote.

What you pay at checkout depends on the method you choose. Some methods take a 50% deposit and charge the balance to that same method no earlier than 48 hours before pickup; others settle in full at checkout and leave nothing due before the ride. Checkout says which applies to yours before you confirm.

Cancellation is decided by the date first. An ordinary date refunds in full 14 or more days ahead; a reservation of 20 or more passengers or 2 or more vehicles refunds in full 30 or more days ahead, with the deposit kept from there in to 14 days; and a major-event date overrides both — its deposit is not refundable and the balance returns only 60 or more days ahead.

Added at the end: 8% Arizona tax, and nothing else — no booking fee and no fuel fee. A promotion code is capped at 10%. Gratuity is optional and is never added for you. Taking the return leg together with the outbound takes 20% off the return leg. An added stop is $50 on a transfer or a round trip and is complimentary on an hourly charter.

Frequently asked questions

Can you collect a Mesa group from several addresses?

Yes. Multi-stop pickup loops are normal here — the vehicle is booked by the hour, so a short run through two or three Mesa neighbourhoods costs the same as sitting still and lands the whole group together.

Which airport should a Mesa booking use?

Phoenix-Mesa Gateway (AZA) is on the southeast side of the city and is often the shorter run from East Mesa and Eastmark; Sky Harbor (PHX) is usually the better choice from West and Central Mesa. We serve both.

Do you run corporate shuttles in Mesa?

Yes. Conference and team-event shuttles are one of the main Mesa jobs — one vehicle, one chauffeur, a fixed loop for the hours you book, rather than a fleet of separate cars to reconcile afterwards.

How is a Mesa booking priced?

By the hour at the vehicle’s published rate with a published minimum. The rate is the same across the metro, so a Mesa pickup is priced exactly like a Scottsdale one.
